'''''Distant Wind''''' was a modified [[XS-800 light freighter/Legends|XS-800 light freighter]] from [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. It was owned by [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] gamester [[Cunbus Locb]].

==History==
The ''Distant Wind'' was a property of [[Cunbus Locb]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] gambler who traveled through several [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel]], [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak]] and [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sectors]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], making a good deal of money, but also some enemies.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

During this time, Locb invested part of his earnings in customized improvements for his ship, including better shields, weapons (such as an additional laser cannon), and engines (increasing its atmospheric speed in 50 [[Kilometer/Legends|km]]/h). Locb also added four hidden smuggling compartments in the ship's common room.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Lastly, he augmented the ''Wind's'' sensor array to detect several [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]]-sized scanners Locb carried with him. The Sullustan strategically placed the scanners in any room he was to play cards at, and then the ship's array could report him the cards other players were holding.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

[[File:XS800LightFreighter-StockShips.png|thumb|left|''Distant Wind'' (not pictured) was an XS-800 like this one.]]

Circa [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Locb discovered that [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ammar]] of Portmoak sector, a noted art collector, owned the well-known [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[Flatsculp/Legends|flatsculp]] "[[Stars and Moons]]." Locb prepared a scheme to trick Ammar and get the flatsculp. He also created a forgery of the artwork and hid it in one of the ship's smuggling compartments, intending to swap it with the original should his scheme failed.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Locb succeeded in winning the piece using cheats, and he hid his prize in another smuggling compartment. However, Ammar discovered the trick and Locb was threatened and [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Ammar seized the ''Wind'' and inspected it thoroughly, but he did not find anything. He finally sent the ship to an open auction.<ref name="Stock Ships" />
